parameters.name: SlideSize

parameters.name: AllowLoss

commands.notes: Template-free creation from the theme. -Password is SecureString; its transformation also accepts a plain string (with a warning) or a PSCredential. The designer-deck engine renders every slide, so deck-plan options live here. Outline route: a Markdown outline becomes a deck through Convert-OfficeDocument -Path .\Review.md -To PowerPoint (headings/--- start slides, lists become PptList, tables/images flow, blockquotes become notes); nothing in this area maps to it.

commands.name: Open-OfficePowerPoint
commands.synopsis: Opens an existing presentation; with a content block, edits, saves and closes it.
commands.notes: Replaces Get-OfficePowerPoint. Opening never restyles the deck; Set-OfficePowerPointTheme -Theme does that on request. New slides added in an opened deck use the deck's own masters and layouts.

commands.name: Save-OfficePowerPoint
commands.synopsis: Saves a live presentation, optionally to a new path.

parameters.name: AllowLoss
parameters.notes: Accept content loss; by default a lossy native save fails.

commands.name: Close-OfficePowerPoint
commands.synopsis: Releases a live presentation without saving.
commands.notes: Saving moved entirely to Save-OfficePowerPoint; Close only disposes. No file-system effect, so no -WhatIf.

commands.name: Export-OfficePowerPoint
commands.synopsis: Turns pipeline objects into a designed deck: title slide, table slides with repeated headers and optional chart slides.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.notes: Title slide text; defaults to the file name.

parameters.name: Property
parameters.notes: Columns to include and their order; default all properties.

parameters.name: Category
parameters.notes: Property used for chart categories. With -Value, adds a chart slide after the table.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.notes: Properties plotted as chart series.

parameters.name: ChartType
parameters.notes: Column by default.

parameters.name: NoTable
parameters.notes: Only the title and chart slides.

parameters.name: MaxRows
parameters.notes: Rows per table slide; default fits the theme's minimum readable size.

commands.notes: Streams rows; long tables split across slides with the header repeated (TitleAndContent layout). First slide uses the Title layout. Replaces an existing file unless -NoClobber.

commands.name: Add-OfficePowerPointSlide
commands.synopsis: Adds a designed slide; the layout is chosen from its content unless -Layout is given.

parameters.name: Eyebrow
parameters.notes: Small label above the title (Title and Section layouts).

parameters.name: Layout
parameters.notes: Optional: Title, Section, TitleAndContent, TwoContent, Comparison, Kpi, Cards, Process, Quote, ImageFull, Closing, CaseStudy, Logos, Coverage. Omitted: first slide Title; title only Section; one block TitleAndContent; two blocks or two PptColumn TwoContent (Comparison when the columns have titles); PptKpi Kpi; PptCard Cards (Logos when every card has -Image and no items; CaseStudy with PptKpi); PptStep Process; PptLocation Coverage.

parameters.name: TemplateLayout
parameters.notes: Escape hatch for a specific master layout: a layout name (exact case preferred, then case-insensitive), 1-based number, PowerPointSlideLayoutType value, or an object from Get-OfficePowerPointLayout.

parameters.name: Master
parameters.notes: 1-based master position for -TemplateLayout; default 1.

parameters.name: Seed
parameters.notes: Overrides the deck seed for this slide's design variant.

commands.notes: Merges the deck-plan commands: semantic slides are ordinary slides whose layout content commands (PptKpi, PptCard, PptStep, PptLocation, PptColumn) select designed layouts. Overflow is handled: lists shrink to the theme minimum then continue on a new slide; tables split with the header repeated. Content blocks run inside New-/Open-OfficePowerPoint or with -Document.

Shared chart parameters: -Category/-Value replace the property-name parameters, also for scatter charts; -Type takes OfficeChartType; the Data alias is removed. Geometry parameters take OfficeLength instead of point doubles; -Column/-Span add theme-grid placement.

Every slide is rendered by the designer engine as it is written, so there is no separate plan-render step. Brand and direction options moved to New-OfficePowerPoint so ordinary slides share the design. -Name comes from -Theme; -NoApplyTheme is the default behavior of Open-OfficePowerPoint (opening never restyles); -Preview is replaced by Get-OfficePowerPointSlide -Summary, which reports each slide's chosen layout; -AlternativeCount was an internal search-width knob whose result is fixed by -Seed.
Geometry parameters take OfficeLength instead of point doubles; -Column/-Span add theme-grid placement. Without placement the image fills the layout's image area.

Deck-plan slides are ordinary PptSlide slides; the layout content commands select the designed layout, so a separate plan object and hashtable inputs are no longer needed. -Seed stays on PptSlide. Capability sections become PptCard items with -Text and -Items (Cards layout, capability composition).

Gains -Title, -Subtitle and an optional designed -Layout chosen from content. Selecting a specific master layout by number, name or type collapses into -TemplateLayout (positions become 1-based; an exact-case name match wins, which replaces -CaseSensitive).

Theme table style by default and automatic splitting across slides with a repeated header. -Property names the columns (was -Header/-Headers); -Style replaces -StyleId; the Data alias is removed. Geometry parameters take OfficeLength instead of point doubles; -Column/-Span add theme-grid placement.
Row positions are 1-based like every other position in the module; the Data/Values aliases are removed.
Kept for deliberate placement. Styled text uses a content block of PptParagraph/PptText; -Run hashtables are removed. Integer points become OfficeLength.

A visual is placed as a picture; every format's image command takes visual objects in a Visual set. Geometry parameters take OfficeLength instead of point doubles; -Column/-Span add theme-grid placement. Pixel-count limits are named ...PixelCount so they are not read as lengths.
Close only releases the document; saving belongs to Save-OfficePowerPoint (or the auto-save of a New-/Open- block).

File-to-file conversion moves to Convert-OfficeDocument -To Html; the PowerPoint-specific switches move to New-OfficePowerPointHtmlOptions passed through -Options. A live deck converts through the Document set; -AsString returns the HTML text instead of writing a file; reports are always written, so -PassThru goes.
-Slide (1-based number or slide object) and -Position (1-based) replace the zero-based -Index and -InsertAt.

Slide image export is one cross-format command. Several slides are several files, so the output is -OutputDirectory, never an -OutputPath that silently becomes a folder; one result per slide is always written, so -PassThru goes. Slide selection and rendering settings stay in New-OfficePowerPointImageOptions via -Options.
Finding shapes by text or pattern is a filter on getting shapes; one command with Text and Pattern sets covers both.
Open- opens files; Get- is for reading content out of a document. -Password becomes SecureString (a plain string or PSCredential is also accepted); -LiteralPath gets its own set.
Validation and preflight that never change the file use the Test- verb; -Document replaces -Presentation and -LiteralPath gets its own set.
-Document replaces -Presentation; -Master is 1-based.
Lengths replace centimeter-suffixed parameters; counts drop the Count suffix; the PptLayoutBox alias goes because Get- commands are not content commands.
Slide placeholders and the slide layout's placeholder metadata are the same question at two levels; -FromLayout selects the layout level.
-Slide accepts a slide object or a 1-based number, replacing the Slide and Presentation+Index sets.
-Type replaces -PlaceholderType (its alias).
-Document replaces -Presentation; -Name accepts wildcards.
Absorbs Find-OfficePowerPointShape. -Slide (object or 1-based number) replaces -Index; -Index now means 1-based shape positions (was -ShapeIndex).
-Slide takes 1-based slide numbers, replacing the zero-based -Index.
A slide summary is another view of the same slides; -Summary returns it, now including the chosen design layout.
-Document replaces -Presentation; the PptTheme alias is removed because Get- commands are not content commands.
-Path/-LiteralPath name the source file (Import- reads it) and -SourceDocument a live source; -SourceSlide (1-based, several allowed) and -Position replace the zero-based -SourceIndex and -InsertAt.

Applies a theme at creation and carries the designer options. -NoSave is removed (leave out the block to get the live deck; -Path is then optional); -AllowLoss accepts a lossy save; -Open becomes -Show; -Force is required to replace a file; -Password is SecureString.
